payload.title: Neutral-pronoun control and accuracy check for twin averaging
payload.description: Add a neutral-pronoun arm (they, and blanked) beside he and she on the bios task to show which direction the pronoun bias runs, and score the twin-averaged verdict against the corpus occupation label to check that removing the variable does not cost accuracy. Prompted by a reader asking whether stripping sex creates more equal distributions. Pre-register before any run; Laya only.
